intro.text: A paraplegic Azish woman who invents aids for people like herself.

items.text: Mura wrote to Rysn by spanreed about the challenges they shared, describing her own inventions, such as hoops, wires and rods to help with dressing, and hooks and pegs for reaching hanging things. She also sent Rysn a design for a self-propelled wheelchair made by an ardent in Jah Keved.
